before.source:
Turns the golem's skin into molten rock. The heat generated sets ablaze everything inside a radius of 3, doing %0.2f fire damage in 3 turns for %d turns.
		Burning is cumulative; the longer they stay within range, they higher the fire damage they take.
		In addition the golem gains %d%% fire resistance.
		Molten Skin damage will not affect friendly creatures.
		The damage and resistance will increase with your Spellpower.
before.target:
使傀儡的皮肤化为熔岩。产生的高温会点燃半径 3 格内的一切，使其在 3 回合内受到 %0.2f 点火焰伤害；炽热皮肤持续 %d 回合。
		灼烧可以叠加；目标处于范围内越久，受到的火焰伤害越高。
		此外，傀儡获得 %d%% 火焰抗性。
		炽热皮肤造成的伤害不会影响友方生物。
		伤害和抗性随你的法术强度提高。

after.target:
使傀儡的皮肤化为熔岩。产生的高温会点燃半径 3 格内的一切，使其在 3 回合内受到 %0.2f 点火焰伤害；炽热皮肤持续 %d 回合。
		灼烧可以叠加；目标处于范围内越久，受到的火焰伤害越高。

		伤害和抗性随你的法术强度提高。

placeholder_bindings.runtime_origin: the same base combatTalentSpellDamage scalar is projected once per active MapEffect full turn before shared-state implicit critical handling
placeholder_bindings.source_explicitness: one fire-damage amount in three turns
placeholder_bindings.target_explicitness_before: one fire-damage amount within three turns
placeholder_bindings.target_explicitness_after: one fire-damage amount within three turns

placeholder_bindings.runtime_origin: the same duration is passed to Map.addEffect and EFF_MOLTEN_SKIN
EFF_MOLTEN_SKIN power adds a temporary FIRE resistance value

outer_duration_and_resistance.map_effect: Map.addEffect receives duration and decrements it once per full effect turn.
outer_duration_and_resistance.resistance: self:setEffect(EFF_MOLTEN_SKIN, duration, {power=30 + combatTalentSpellDamage(...)}) grants FIRE resistance for the same duration.
outer_duration_and_resistance.tooltip: tformat argument 2 binds the same duration to %d; argument 3 binds resistance power to %d%%.

map_effect_pulses_and_movement.full_turn: When update_shape_only is false and duration > 0, Map.processEffects projects e.dam once across the current grids and decrements duration.
map_effect_pulses_and_movement.movement_update: The update callback assigns e.x/e.y from e.src.x/e.src.y and Map.processEffects rebuilds circle_grids; shape-only calls update movement without projecting damage.

recipient_filter.normal_living_summoner: With a present living summoner, reactionToward(target) < 0 admits only that summoner's enemies.
recipient_filter.missing_or_dead_summoner_boundary: With no summoner or a dead summoner, the guard is skipped and every actor other than the golem itself is admitted.
recipient_filter.translation_relation: The repaired Chinese limits its enemy-only statement to the living-summoner condition and does not describe the exceptional branch's internal behavior.

implicit_critical_state.flow: MapEffect invokes GOLEM_FIREBURN without an explicit state; GOLEM_FIREBURN initializes state, calls useImplicitCrit, and passes that same state into FIREBURN, whose useImplicitCrit sees the shared projection state.
implicit_critical_state.qualification: This is one shared implicit-critical projection state, not two independent critical rolls.
implicit_critical_state.tooltip: %0.2f remains the uncritted FIRE-adjusted display value.

scalar_fireburn.incoming_total: D = the per-active-turn scalar dam delegated by GOLEM_FIREBURN
scalar_fireburn.defaults: scalar input selects dur=3 and initial percent=50
scalar_fireburn.immediate: D/2 is projected immediately as FIRE
scalar_fireburn.burning: the remaining D/2 is installed as EFF_BURNING with power (D/2)/3
scalar_fireburn.complete_total: D is the complete event total, not each timeout amount.

burning_merge.qualification: Repeated applications pool remaining totals; they do not retain independent isolated schedules.

translation_semantics.source_claim: Each active aura pulse supplies one complete %0.2f fire-damage amount delivered within three turns; the aura itself lasts %d turns.
translation_semantics.target_claim: 使其在 3 回合内受到 %0.2f 点火焰伤害；炽热皮肤持续 %d 回合 separates the complete three-turn event amount from the outer aura lifetime; 召唤者存活时，炽热皮肤只会伤害召唤者的敌人 limits the recipient claim to the source-confirmed living-summoner condition.

confirmed.subject: outer duration, pulses, and movement
confirmed.finding: The map effect and resistance last 5 + talent level; the effect pulses once per active full turn and follows the golem.

confirmed.subject: recipient and critical handling
confirmed.finding: GOLEM_FIREBURN excludes self, normally filters by living-summoner hostility, preserves the dead/missing-summoner exception, and shares one implicit-critical projection state with FIREBURN.

confirmed.subject: complete event and cumulative pool
confirmed.finding: Scalar FIREBURN splits one complete total half immediate and half over three turns; BURNING merges remaining pools.

confirmed.subject: translation accuracy
confirmed.finding: The Chinese distinguishes the three-turn complete amount from outer duration and makes no per-turn numeric claim.

confirmed.subject: unqualified friendly-target statement
confirmed.finding: At fixed commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63, GOLEM_FIREBURN filters by the living summoner's hostility only when that summoner exists and is alive; when the summoner is missing or dead, it admits every actor except the golem itself. The former Chinese sentence was therefore an incorrect unconditional claim.

applied_repairs.before: 炽热皮肤造成的伤害不会影响友方生物。
applied_repairs.after: 召唤者存活时，炽热皮肤只会伤害召唤者的敌人。
applied_repairs.scope: Minimal repair states only the normal living-summoner behavior and does not expand the missing/dead-summoner branch implementation into the player-facing target.
